summary: Iteration 7 — verified BOTH reported bugs are fixed. (1) Per-photo basic correction: jest suite 9/9 passes including 3 new autoBasicFromMetrics tests (dark luma -> +EV, bright luma -> -EV, differ). Backend /api/projects/{id}/generate-xmp with photos[] returns DARK.xmp with crs:Exposure2012="+0.85" and BRIGHT.xmp with "-0.60" (different per photo, matching per-photo basic). (2) Preset passthrough: creative attrs (Clarity2012=30, Vibrance=25, Texture=18, SplitToningShadowHue=220) preserved in every output while Exposure2012 is replaced by the per-photo value (not the preset's +1.50). Legacy filenames+parameters path still works; empty body -> 400. Cloud job accepts photos+preset_xmp, stores them, and download ZIP is .xmp-only with the same per-photo exposure + preserved creative attrs. Full regression: 36/36 pytest tests pass (1 wikipedia/happy paid-LLM test deselected as instructed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: build_xmp() has a convoluted ternary on line 352 mixing exposure format with a fallback that never triggers for keys other than 'exposure' — works but is hard to read; consider using _fmt_basic()/BASIC_ATTR_MAP consistently in the legacy path too.

PhotoBasic.basic is typed Dict[str, float] but real payloads pass Optional[None] via .get() in build_photo_xmp — fine, but Pydantic will coerce numeric strings which may hide client bugs; consider explicit typed fields.
server.py: single-file 852 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; recommend splitting XMP generation, cloud jobs, and photographer-style modules.
download_cloud_job returns 409 when not completed, but polling clients still get 200 from GET /cloud-jobs/{id}; consider surfacing 'failed' state clearly in the download error message.
test_credentials: Seeded via MongoDB per /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Bearer session token). Ephemeral per-test-session user, cleaned up on teardown.
seed_data_creation: Test user + user_sessions inserted in test_database and cleaned up in module-scoped fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New XMP payload shape: {photos:[{filename,basic:{...}}], creative_params:{}, preset_xmp?:str}. Legacy shape {filenames:[], parameters:{}} still supported. When preset_xmp is provided, only BASIC_ATTR_MAP keys (exposure/contrast/highlights/shadows/whites/blacks) are substituted; all other crs:* attrs from the preset are preserved verbatim by _set_crs_attr(). Cloud job persists photos + preset_xmp and generates the ZIP on download via xmp_entries(). Note: pytest.ini enables xdist by default; use `-p xdist -n 0` to run serially when needed. Full-browser upload flow (canvas metrics) is not headless-testable.
